about: Kana teaching notes. 'aid' is an original memory aid (a mnemonic, not history). 'origin' is the man'yōgana kanji the kana developed from: hiragana from cursive forms, katakana from a part of the kanji. 'tell' explains how to separate the kana from look-alikes. AI-assisted draft; origins follow the standard tables and still need human review.
tips: Kana form a grid: vowels a i u e o across, consonants k s t n h m y r w down. か き く け こ is just k + each vowel. Learn a row, then say it in order.
Say it while you watch it
Play the strokes and say the sound out loud at the same time. Sound and shape stored together come back together.
Cover the answer and try before you look. A wrong guess you correct is remembered better than a right answer you read.
゛ (dakuten) voices a sound: k→g, s→z, t→d, h→b. ゜ (handakuten) turns h into p. か→が, は→ば→ぱ.
Small ゃ ゅ ょ make one beat
After an i-column kana they merge: き + ゃ = kya, し + ょ = sho. One beat, not two.
A small っ holds your breath for one beat before the next consonant: きて kite, きって kitte.
Katakana spell the same sounds with straighter strokes. They mark loanwords and emphasis. ー stretches the vowel before it: コーヒー kōhī.
Five minutes today and five tomorrow beat thirty minutes once. Your reviews come back when they are about to fade.

あ.aid: An antenna: a cross on top, a wire curling below it. 'Ah', the signal is in.
あ.tell: あ has the cross and no dot; お has a flick at the top right; め has no cross.

い.aid: Two eels side by side, the left one a little longer: 'ee'.
い.tell: い is wide and short, the left stroke hooks; り is tall, the right stroke is long.

う.aid: A face in profile with a dash for a brow and an open mouth saying 'oo'.
う.tell: う has a dash on top; つ has none; ら's top dash leans and its body is closed.

え.aid: An exotic bird: a crest on top, then a zigzag body that kicks to the right.
え.tell: え has a separate dash on top and ends in a flat kick.

お.aid: Like あ, with a little splash at the top right: 'Oh!'
お.tell: お has the extra dot at the top right; あ does not.

か.aid: A karate chop: the hooked stroke is the arm, the dash beside it the spark of the hit.
か.tell: か has a single dash on the right; が adds the two voicing marks.

き.aid: A key: two teeth across the shaft, a curl at the bottom for the handle.
き.tell: き has two crossbars; さ has one; ま has a loop.

く.aid: A cuckoo's open beak: <. One stroke.
く.tell: く opens to the right like <; へ is a roof ^.

け.aid: A keg on a stand: a post on the left, a tap and barrel on the right.
け.tell: け's right side has no loop; は ends in a loop.

こ.aid: Two short coils lying one above the other: 'ko'.
こ.tell: こ is two horizontal strokes; に adds a post on the left.

さ.aid: A samurai's face: a crossbar for the brows, a curved beard that opens to the left.
さ.tell: さ's bottom curve opens to the LEFT like a c; ち's belly bulges to the RIGHT.

し.aid: A shepherd's crook, one stroke that hooks up to the right: 'shee'.
し.tell: し is vertical; つ is horizontal.

す.aid: A swing: a crossbar, then a rope that loops once and drops.
す.tell: す has one crossbar and the loop sits on the vertical; む has a dot on the right.

せ.aid: A seat seen from the side: a long bench with two back posts.
せ.tell: せ has a long crossbar and the left post curls into a cup.

そ.aid: A sewing thread zigzagging down the cloth: 'so'.
そ.tell: そ zigzags and ends with an open curve; え has a separate dash on top.

た.aid: Literally ta: the left part is a t, the right part looks like a small a.
た.tell: た's right side is two flat strokes; な has a knot.

ち.aid: A cheerleader leaning back: crossbar for the arms, belly bulging out to the right.
ち.tell: ち's belly bulges to the RIGHT; さ's curve opens to the LEFT.

つ.aid: A tsunami wave rolling in from the left: one sweeping stroke.
つ.tell: つ lies flat; し stands up; う has a dash on top.

て.aid: A hand (手, te) reaching right, then curling down.
て.tell: て is one stroke with a flat top.

と.aid: A toe with a thorn stuck in it: a short slanted spike on a curved toe.
と.tell: と has two strokes; the small spike leans into the curve.

な.aid: A cross, and a knot tied beneath it: 'na'.
な.tell: な has a small dash between the cross and a looped knot.

に.aid: A post with 二 (ni, two) beside it.
に.tell: に is a post plus two short strokes; た's post has a crossbar.

ぬ.aid: Noodles on chopsticks: two crossing strokes, then a twirl that ends in a little loop.
ぬ.tell: ぬ ends in a LOOP at the bottom right; め does not.

ね.aid: A cat (neko): the post is its body, the curl at the end its tail.
ね.tell: Same left post for all three: ね ends in a loop, れ kicks out, わ curves round.

の.aid: A 'no' sign: one sweep round with a slash through it.

は.aid: Ha: a post on the left, and on the right a crossbar with a hanging loop.
は.tell: は has one crossbar on the right; ほ has two; け has no loop.

ひ.tell: ひ is one stroke that dips and rises.

ふ.aid: Mount Fuji: a dot on the peak, a curve, and two puffs of cloud on the sides.
ふ.tell: ふ has four strokes spread apart; it is the only kana written fu.

へ.aid: A small hill: head up the hill, 'he'. Hiragana and katakana are almost identical.
へ.tell: へ is a roof ^; く opens sideways <.

ほ.aid: Like は with a lid: two crossbars on the right, a 'ho'ld on top.
ほ.tell: ほ has two crossbars; は has one.

ま.aid: A mast with two sails and a loop at the bottom: 'ma'.
ま.tell: ま has two crossbars over a looped stem; も's stem hooks without a loop.

み.aid: A loop and a long tail, then a dash crossing it: 'mee'.
み.tell: み has the separate crossing dash.

む.aid: A cow ('moo'): a looped body and a small horn dot on the right.
む.tell: む has a dot on the right and a hook at the bottom.

め.aid: An eye (目, me) with a curled lash: like ぬ without the little loop.
め.tell: め has no loop at the end; ぬ does.

も.aid: A fishhook with two worms on it: 'mo' bait.
も.tell: も has two crossbars on a hook that is open at the bottom.

や.aid: A yak's horns: a curved stroke, a short dash, a long slanted stroke.
や.tell: や has three strokes and the long one slants down to the left.

ゆ.aid: A fish in a bowl, a line straight through it: 'yu'.
ゆ.tell: ゆ has a loop and a vertical stroke cutting through.

よ.aid: A yo-yo hanging from a short bar.
よ.tell: よ has one short bar on the right, then a loop.

ら.aid: A rabbit: an ear on top, a round body below.
ら.tell: ら's top is a tilted dash and the body is not closed.

り.aid: Two reeds in the wind, the right one longer: 'ree'.
り.tell: り is tall with a long right stroke; い is short and wide.

る.aid: A road that ends in a loop: 'loop' → 'ru'.
る.tell: る ends in a LOOP; ろ ends open.

れ.aid: A dancer kicking out straight: like ね, but the tail kicks out instead of looping.
れ.tell: れ's right side ends in an outward kick.

ろ.aid: A road that bends and stops, with no loop: 'ro'.
ろ.tell: ろ is る without the loop.

わ.aid: Like ね and れ, but the right side curves into a round wall: 'wa'.
わ.tell: わ's right side curves round and stops.

を.aid: A man leaping over a hurdle, 'whoa'. Pronounced o, used almost only as the object marker.
を.tell: を has three strokes and a zigzag in the middle.

ん.aid: A cursive n: the only kana that is a consonant on its own.
ん.tell: ん is one stroke that dips and rises.

ア.aid: An axe: a hooked blade on top, a handle sweeping down.
ア.tell: ア has a short stroke down from the middle; マ has a flick inside.

イ.tell: イ is two strokes, a slant and a straight post.

ウ.aid: う under a roof: a dot, a lid, and the open curve below.
ウ.tell: ウ has the dot on top; ワ has no dot.

エ.aid: An elevator shaft: two floors and a beam between them.
エ.tell: エ is symmetric; ユ is open on the left.

オ.aid: An old man with a cane: a cross and a stroke leaning off it.
オ.tell: オ has one leaning stroke; ホ has two feet.

カ.aid: Same as か, without the extra dash.
カ.tell: カ is the kana; 力 (power) is a kanji that looks the same.

キ.aid: A key with two teeth, like き without the bottom curl.
キ.tell: キ has two crossbars crossed by one post.

ク.aid: A cook's hook with a lid on top.
ク.tell: ク is two strokes; タ adds a dash inside; ケ has a crossbar sticking out.

ケ.aid: Like け missing its right post: a keg's tap.
ケ.tell: ケ's crossbar sticks out to the right.

コ.aid: A corner of a box, open on the left: 'ko'.
コ.tell: コ is open on the left; ロ is closed; ユ has a long bottom.

サ.aid: A saw frame: a crossbar with two legs, one bending away.
サ.tell: サ has two posts crossing one bar.

シ.aid: She smiles: dots stacked down the LEFT, the stroke rising from the bottom up.
シ.tell: シ: dots sit one above the other on the left; the last stroke goes UP. ツ: dots sit side by side on top; the stroke comes DOWN.

ス.aid: A hiker striding: a roof and one long step.
ス.tell: ス's second stroke leaves from the end of the roof; ヌ's crosses it.

セ.aid: Like せ, sharper: a bench with one back post.
セ.tell: セ has one bent post and a crossbar.

ソ.aid: A stitch sewn DOWN: a dot, then a long stroke falling from the top right.
ソ.tell: ソ's long stroke falls DOWN from the top; ン's rises UP from the bottom.

タ.aid: Like ク with an extra dash inside: 'ta'.
タ.tell: タ has a dash inside the hook.

チ.aid: A cheerleader with arms out: a slanted top, a crossbar, a falling leg.
チ.tell: チ's top stroke slants; テ's two bars are flat.

ツ.aid: A tsunami falling from the sky: two dots side by side on top, the wave coming DOWN.
ツ.tell: ツ: dots side by side on top, last stroke falls DOWN. シ: dots stacked on the left, last stroke goes UP.

テ.aid: A telegraph pole: two crossbars and a wire hanging down.

ト.aid: A totem pole with one short branch.
ト.tell: ト is a post with a dash to the right.

ナ.tell: ナ's crossbar is flat; メ is an X.

ニ.tell: ニ is the kana; 二 (two) is the kanji. In words they look the same; context tells them apart.

ヌ.aid: A chopstick crossing noodles: a hook and one stroke slashing through.
ヌ.tell: ヌ's second stroke crosses the first.

ネ.aid: A necktie on a stand: a dot, a hook, and two legs.
ネ.tell: ネ has a dot on top.

ハ.aid: Two lines like a laughing mouth: 'ha ha'.
ハ.tell: ハ is the kana; 八 (eight) is the kanji with the same shape.

ヒ.aid: A heel: a post that bends into a foot, with a dash.
ヒ.tell: ヒ is two strokes, the dash on top.

フ.aid: Mount Fuji's slope: one roof that falls away.
フ.tell: フ is one stroke; ワ adds a post on the left.

ヘ.aid: A small hill, the same as hiragana へ.
ヘ.tell: Hiragana へ and katakana ヘ are nearly identical; the word around it tells you which.

ホ.aid: A holy cross with two little feet.
ホ.tell: ホ has two short feet; オ has one leaning stroke.

マ.aid: A bent arm with a small flick inside: 'ma'.
マ.tell: マ's inner flick points down and right.

ミ.tell: ミ's strokes slant; 三's are flat.

ム.tell: ム is a closed corner with a dot on the right.

メ.aid: X marks the eye (me) on the treasure map.

モ.aid: Like も with straight lines: two bars and a hook.
モ.tell: モ's post hooks right at the bottom.

ユ.aid: A U-turn on the road, flat at the bottom.
ユ.tell: ユ's bottom stroke runs long past the corner.

ヨ.tell: ヨ has three bars closed on the right.

ラ.aid: Like ら: a short lid, then a hook.
ラ.tell: ラ has a separate short bar on top.

リ.aid: Like り: two reeds, the right one long.
リ.tell: リ's two strokes are both vertical.

ル.aid: Two roots, the right one kicking up.
ル.tell: ル's right stroke kicks up at the end.

レ.aid: A leg with a kick, like a check mark.

ロ.tell: ロ is the kana; 口 (mouth) is the kanji with almost the same shape.

ワ.aid: A water scoop: a post and a lid that curves down.
ワ.tell: ワ has no dot on top; ウ does.

ヲ.aid: フ with a bar through it: rare, the object marker in katakana.
ヲ.tell: ヲ is open on the left.

ン.aid: The n sound: a dot, and a stroke that rises UP from the bottom left.
ン.tell: ン's long stroke goes UP from the bottom; ソ's falls DOWN from the top.
